input.subject: [E20] Used Xbox Controller
input.body: Hey ByteMart, I received my Xbox Wireless Controller today, but the controller box appears to have been tampered with, and the controller looks used. It has fingerprint-like grease marks on it. I would like to request a replacement with a new and unused controller. Please let me know the next steps.
